title: Getting around
goal: Ask for and give directions, take buses, autos and the metro, and tell a driver where to go.
intro:
Getting around Bengaluru means autos (ಆಟೋ), BMTC buses, the Namma Metro, and a lot of patience in traffic. Knowing a few Kannada phrases will get you better fares and friendlier help.

This unit covers **commands** (informal and polite) and the cases of **direction**: -ಗೆ 'to', -ಇಂದ 'from' and -ವರೆಗೆ 'up to'.

vocab.note: To the right: ಬಲಕ್ಕೆ balakke / ಬಲಗಡೆ balagaḍe. Spoken also ರೈಟ್.
To the left: ಎಡಕ್ಕೆ eḍakke / ಎಡಗಡೆ eḍagaḍe.
ಈ ಕಡೆ 'this way', ಆ ಕಡೆ 'that way', ಮನೆ ಕಡೆ 'towards home'.
Spoken often ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ: ಎಡಕ್ಕೆ ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ 'take a left'.

vocab.en: to climb; to get on (a vehicle)

vocab.note: ಬಸ್ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣ 'bus stand'; spoken ಸ್ಟಾಪ್ / ಸ್ಟೇಷನ್.
In Karnataka ಹೋಟೆಲ್ usually means a place to eat; a place to stay is a ಲಾಡ್ಜ್ or hotel.

vocab.en: until, up to, as far as

phrases.en: Excuse me, which way to the metro station?
How far is it from here?
Will you go to Majestic? (to an auto driver)
Does this bus go to Jayanagar?
Get off at the next stop.
I'm lost. (lit. I've missed the way)

grammar.title: Commands: informal, polite and 'let's'
grammar.body:
**Informal** (ನೀನು) command = the bare verb stem: ಮಾಡು 'do', ಹೋಗು 'go', ನೋಡು 'look', ಕುಡಿ 'drink', ತಿನ್ನು 'eat'. Irregular: ಬರು → **ಬಾ** 'come'.

**Polite / plural** (ನೀವು) command = stem + **-ಇ**: ಮಾಡಿ, ಹೋಗಿ, ನೋಡಿ, ತಿನ್ನಿ, ನಿಲ್ಲಿ. Verbs ending in -ಇ/-ಎ add **-ಯಿರಿ** (spoken -ಈರಿ): ಕುಡಿಯಿರಿ / ಕುಡೀರಿ, ಇಳಿಯಿರಿ / ಇಳೀರಿ. Irregular: ಬರು → **ಬನ್ನಿ** 'come'.

**Negative** command: infinitive + **-ಬೇಡ** (inf.) / **-ಬೇಡಿ** (pol.): ಹೋಗಬೇಡ / ಹೋಗಬೇಡಿ 'don't go'.

**'Let's'** (hortative): stem + **-ಓಣ**: ಹೋಗೋಣ 'let's go', ಮಾಡೋಣ 'let's do it', ತಿನ್ನೋಣ 'let's eat'. Add -ಆ to ask 'shall we?': ಹೋಗೋಣವಾ? / ಹೋಗೋಣ್ವಾ?

Many 'causative' verbs ending in -ಇಸು are used for vehicles: ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸು 'stop (the vehicle)', ಓಡಿಸು 'drive'.

examples.en: Turn left and stop near the circle.

grammar.title: Direction: -ಗೆ 'to', -ಇಂದ 'from', ವರೆಗೆ 'up to'
grammar.body:
**To / towards** = dative **-ಗೆ** (after -ಇ/-ಎ), **-ಇಗೆ** (after -ಉ words and consonant-final loans), **-ಕ್ಕೆ** (after -ಅ): ಮನೆಗೆ 'to the house', ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿಗೆ 'to Bengaluru', ಬಸ್ಸಿಗೆ 'for the bus', ಜಯನಗರಕ್ಕೆ 'to Jayanagar', ಆಫೀಸಿಗೆ 'to the office'.

**From** = ablative **-ಇಂದ** *-inda*: ಮನೆಯಿಂದ 'from the house', ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನಿಂದ 'from Bengaluru', ಇಲ್ಲಿಂದ 'from here', ಅಲ್ಲಿಂದ 'from there'. -ಇಂದ also means 'by means of, because of' and 'since' (ಎರಡು ದಿನದಿಂದ 'for/since two days').

**Up to / until** = genitive + **ವರೆಗೆ**: ಮೈಸೂರಿನವರೆಗೆ 'as far as Mysuru', ಐದು ಗಂಟೆವರೆಗೆ 'until five'. Spoken: ಮೈಸೂರ್ ತನಕ.

**By (vehicle)** = locative: ಬಸ್ಸಲ್ಲಿ 'by bus', ಮೆಟ್ರೋದಲ್ಲಿ 'by metro', ಕಾರಲ್ಲಿ 'by car'.

examples.en: How much from here to the station?
They're going to Hubballi by train.
I'll pop to the shop and come back.
It takes an hour from home to the office.

dialogue.title: Taking an auto
dialogue.setting: Emma flags down an auto-rickshaw outside a mall in Koramangala.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.en: Brother, will you go to Malleswaram?

lines.speaker: Driver
lines.en: Malleswaram is very far. It'll be three hundred.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.native: ಮೀಟರ್ ಹಾಕಿ, ಮೀಟರ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ಕೊಡ್ತೀನಿ.
lines.roman: mīṭar hāki, mīṭar mēle ippattu koḍtīni.
lines.en: Put the meter on, I'll give twenty over the meter.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.native: ಬಲಕ್ಕೆ ತಿರುಗಿ, ಆಮೇಲೆ ಸೀದಾ ಹೋಗಿ. ಇಲ್ಲೇ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ.
lines.roman: balakke tirugi, āmēle sīdā hōgi. illē nillisi.
lines.en: Turn right, then go straight. Stop right here.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.en: Here you go, two hundred and thirty. Thanks!

culture: Bengaluru addresses use ಕ್ರಾಸ್ (cross roads) and ಮೇನ್ (main roads), plus a landmark: '8th Cross, near the Ganesha temple'. Landmarks matter more than street names. Auto drivers often open with ಬರ್ತೀರಾ? 'will you come?' answered by a price; speaking Kannada usually earns you the meter fare. Calling the driver ಅಣ್ಣ or ಗುರು is friendly and normal.
